Scientist.This position has a hybrid setup with approximately 1 - 2 days per week on site.This position is part time eligible with 80 %.Tasks & responsibilities- In your new role, you will be guidance to internal and external projects and stakeholders and provide strategic input for multi-project and portfolio initiatives and disease area strategies.- In addition, you will lead end to end enable filing of novel and differentiated MoAs in our core indications.Requirements- PhD and/or MD degree with long term experience in research, industry or clinical setting, including several years of demonstrated biomarker-related work experience in the context of drug development- Proven ability to lead cross-functional matrix teams, drive strategic decision-making, and effectively prioritize deep understanding of biomarker applications across the drug development lifecycle. Tätigkeitsbereich: IT/TelekommunikationFachabteilung: Payment-related ProductsGesellschaft: Mercedes pay GmbHStandort: BerlinStartdatum: 01.06.2026Veröffentlichungsdatum: 01.06.2026Stellennummer: MER00044HAArbeitszeit: Full timeAufgabenWHAT WE DOPicture the car of the future. Does it fly? Does it look like the one from that famous 80s movie?We believe the car of the future is already here—and it’s a connected vehicle that can be used as a payment device. Here at Mercedes pay, we enable seamless, secure, and trustworthy payments across the entire Mercedes-Benz ecosystem. We develop sleek new payment products & solutions to provide customers with an effortless, convenient user experience; not just via an app or web browser, but even in-car. The car as a payment device? We made it happen!Mercedes-Benz is known for its legacy, but innovation and legacy are not mutually exclusive—quite the contrary. Our mission is to empower innovation within one of the top luxury car brands worldwide, helping it continue to pioneer the automotive industry. To sum it up, we are the FinTech branch or knowledge hub for payments within Mercedes-Benz.ABOUT MERCEDES PAYMercedes pay launched in its first market in 2018 and is now active in more than 40 countries on five continents, enabling transaction processing for Mercedes-Benz products and services. Depending on the market, Mercedes pay may act as the technical payment gateway for transaction processing from Mercedes me store, the Mercedes me app, in-car payments and may even support online vehicle sales. This is how Mercedes pay directly contributes to the mobility and digitalization strategy of Mercedes-Benz Group AG. Mercedes pay is a wholly owned subsidiary of Mercedes-Benz AG with offices in Berlin, Stuttgart, and Farmington Hills (USA).2023 has already been a big year—we launched full online vehicle payments in the UK and introduced native in-car payments in Germany, an industry-first feature by which users can pay directly by fingerprint inside their car. That’s the car of the future we’re talking about!OUR VALUES & HOW WE WORKWe are an inclusive, passionate, and diverse team of people. Being solution-oriented, agile, and dynamic is in our blood. We learn best by leaping into cold water from time to time, by doing rather than deliberating, and we trust in our teammates’ abilities & willingness to learn. We like to make things happen, and we’re more interested in finding solutions than sulking at inconveniences.Since we are still building new processes alongside new products, new joiners have the opportunity to make as much impact as our most seasoned veterans. We really love a lively exchange of ideas, whether a teammate’s been with us for two days or ten years. And, frankly, fresh energy is always welcome. YOUR DAY AT GLANCEYou assess current systems, infrastructure, and business processes to identify improvement opportunities and ensure compatibility with new solutions- You collect and analyze stakeholder requirements to define solution scope and objectives- You architect the Mercedes Pay Digital Voucher Solution, detailing structure, components, interfaces, and data flows, and select suitable technologies, platforms, and tools- You create proof-of-concept projects to validate solutions and demonstrate feasibility- You work with an experienced team of Solution Architects as well as the company's Enterprise, Cloud and Security Architects to derive right-fit solutions- You facilitate the collaboration with external development teams, ensuring adherence to architectural guidelines and best practices- You communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders, translating complex technical details into accessible language- You document solutions and disseminate best practices among team membersQualifikationenWHAT YOU BRING TO THE TABLE- You hold a degree in Computer Science or a related field- You have 5+ years of experience as a Solution Architect, with a strong focus on software product development- You have practical experience in at least one of the following domains: regulatory environments, agentic commerce, loyalty programs, vouchers, digital marketing, or payments (including PCI DSS, PSD2/SCA, or AML/KYC)- You are proficient in microservices, event-driven architectures, cloud-native technologies (e.g., Kubernetes, CI/CD), Auth 2.0 and OpenID Connect (OIDC) protocols, alongside practices like Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and DevOps- You have hands-on experience with tools such as Jira, GitHub, and Datadog- You have a proven track record of implementing cutting-edge technologies within a corporate environment- You possess strong teamwork and good communication skills, with the ability to maintain composure under pressure- You are fluent in English; German language skills are a strong plusOUR OFFER TO YOU·       Modern and dynamic work environment·       Flexible and mobile working·       Attractive fitness offer·       Numerous employee discounts·       Excellent infrastructureThis is a full-time job (also suitable for part-time). We particularly welcome applications from disabled persons. Please apply online via www.group.mercedes-benz.com/careers (ID:MER0003ZHV). For questions, please don’t hesitate to contact the HR Team of Mercedes pay GmbH: career_mercedespay@mercedes-benz.comBenefits- Barriere­frei­heit- Coaching- Betriebs­arzt- Mit­arbeiter Events- Mit­arbeiter­rabatte möglich- Mit­arbeiter­beteili­gung möglich- Mit­arbeiter­handy möglich- Essens­zulagen- Gesund­heits­maß­nahmen- Hybrides Arbeiten möglich- Lebens­langes Lernen- Betrieb­liche Alters­ver­sorgung- Park­platz- Gute An­bindung- Flexible Arbeits­zeit möglichKontaktNatali KosEmail: natali.kos@mercedes-benz.comOtto-Braun-Strasse 7810249 Berlin
